about.title: How it works & privacy
about.disclaimer: AI reads your belly progress from the photos. It's not a measurement.
about.confidence: Confidence is an estimate from the photo, not a measurement.
about.duration: Usually 5-20 seconds. The original photo is only stored for you.
about.photoPrivate: Your belly photo is private: it never reaches the feed and only you can open it.
about.retry: Recalculate: the AI compares the same two photos again. No new photo, and it doesn't use your daily scan quota.
about.retryShared: The status shared with {{group}} updates too.
about.share: Only the verdict and date are visible. Your belly photo is never shared.
about.waist: A photo is only a visual estimate. The tape measure is what measures.

capture.guide: Keep your belly inside the dashed line

analyzing.compare: AI is comparing with your last scan…

capture.cameraUnavailable: Camera isn't available on this device. Use the gallery button below, or allow the camera in your browser settings.

permission.text: No camera permission. Use the gallery, or allow the camera first.

tips.pose: Same pose and distance every scan
tips.light: Bright light, camera level with your belly

capture.savedNone: Your first scan becomes the starting point.

error.process: Couldn't process the photo. Try again.
error.capture: Couldn't take the photo. Try again.

retry.title: Not quite right?
retry.exhausted: This scan has hit its recalculation limit. Scan again another day.
retry.hint: Quick correction (optional), e.g. both photos had the same pose

toast.on: Belly scan shared with the group.

live.hiddenNote: Their total calories are still visible on their member card.
live.hiddenNoteNudge: Their total calories are still visible on their member card. Give them a poke for motivation.
live.basis: Based on {{name}}'s food log today, not a real photo.

error.network: Couldn't scan. Check your connection and try again.

live.checking: VAR is checking the food log…
live.noCamera: Camera isn't available. The overlay still works, or allow the camera in your browser settings.
live.permissionHint: No camera permission: shadow mode. VAR still works!

errors.compareFailed: VAR couldn't compare the photos. Try again with better light, or retry tomorrow.
errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save the photo. Please try again.
errors.firstScanNote: First scan saved. Scan again another day to start comparing.
errors.noBaseline: The first scan has nothing to compare with, so it can't be recalculated.
errors.photoGone: The scan photos are no longer stored, so it can't be recalculated.
errors.retriesExhausted_one: You've used the {{count}} recalculation allowed for this scan. Scan again another day.
errors.retriesExhausted_other: You've used all {{count}} recalculations allowed for this scan. Scan again another day.
